messages.author: KAJAL ABROL
messages.body:
Dear AMBER community,
prepi file has been successfully generated for phosphate ion but frcmod
file is generated but not showing any information.
Blank frcmod file is generated as below:
Remark line goes here
MASS
BOND
ANGLE
DIHE
IMPROPER
BONBON
I have used this command:
parmchk2 -i phosphate.prepi -o phosphate.frcmod -f prepi -nc -3 -p
gaff_parm99m.dat
Please suggest me any solution.
Thanks and Regards,
Kajal Abrol
Research Scholar
Department of Bioinformatics
Pondicherry University
Puducherry
India

messages.author: Daniel Roe
messages.body:
Hi,
I believe if you're getting a blank frcmod file from parmchk, that
means no additional parameters are required. So all necessary
parameters are already in gaff_parm99m.dat.
-Dan
